values.note: Reservable online or at 1-888-432-2267 up to 365 days ahead and at least one day before arrival; 'strongly recommended Memorial Day weekend through Labor Day'. Garrett Loop is reservable from the first weekend in April to the first weekend in December (2026: April 3 - December 13), Tolliver Loop only Memorial Day to Labor Day. DNR's camping page states the weekend minimum without a season ('a two night minimum stay for weekends and a three night minimum stay for holiday weekends'). Check-in 3 p.m. (before 10 p.m.), check-out noon; at most six people and two vehicles a site.

booking.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/SwallowFalls/Camping.aspx ('All campsites in the Garrett Loop can be reserved from the 1st weekend in April until the 1st weekend in December. All campsites in the Tolliver Loop can be reserved from the Friday before Memorial Day until Labor Day.'; 'There is a two night minimum stay for weekends and a three night minimum stay for holiday weekends.'; check-in/out and occupancy rules) + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/swallow-falls-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380133 (Booking Window: 'Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 365 Day(s) in advance.'; 2026/2027 Reservable Dates), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/SwallowFalls/Camping.aspx ('Three of the sites are full hook-up which includes electric, water and sewer (40, 42 & 42A) and three sites have water and electric (19, 21, 23).') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/swallow-falls-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380133 (per-site details: all six hookup sites 'Electrical Service (amp): 30', Water Service Y; the three Garrett Loop full-hookup sites Sewer Service Y), read 2026-10-21

values.note: DNR lists every site: about a dozen take a trailer or RV over 20 ft (sites 2, 4-7, 9, 11, 13, 15, 27, 35, 40 and 42A at 25-35 ft); most of the rest are tents, pop-ups and truck campers only. Of the hookup sites, full-hookup 40 (25 ft) and 42A (30 ft) fit a 23-ft rig; the water/electric sites 19, 21 and 23 (Tolliver Loop) are 20-ft / pop-up and truck-camper sites.

sites.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/SwallowFalls/Camping.aspx ('Sixty-five (65) wooded campsites'; Campsite Information list, e.g. 'Site # 6 - Tents, Pop Up, Truck Campers, Trailer or RV up to 35''; 'Site # 19 - Tents, Pop Up, Truck Campers') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/swallow-falls-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380133 (Campsite Electric sites Max Vehicle Length 20), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/SwallowFalls/Camping.aspx ('All camp sites are located near modern bath houses with hot and cold water.') + https://parkreservations.maryland.gov/camping/swallow-falls-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MD&parkId=380133 (Services and Amenities Within Park: 'Dump Station', 'Restrooms', 'Showers'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed fees ($21.50 / $27.50 / $32.50 on oc.aspx and the booking site's rate table), reservable 365 days ahead. Added: booking closes one day before arrival, the park's own weekend 2-night / holiday 3-night minimum (no summer qualifier on its page), 30-amp with water and sewer at 3 full-hookup sites, 65 sites to 35 ft, bathhouses with showers, dump. Not stated: a campground season beyond the reservable dates (left unset), walk-ups (fcfs left inherited).
flags: Fit: only about a dozen of the 65 sites take a trailer/RV over 20 ft, and the three $27.50 water/electric sites are 20-ft / tents-pop-ups-truck-campers sites, so a 23-ft rig's choices are the $21.50 non-electric 25-35 ft sites or full-hookup 40/42A at $32.50. The entry's manual fees.surcharges electric +6 is real but unusable for EKKO (not overwritten).

Phone: entry has none; DNR gives '301-387-6938 - Swallow Falls State Park Office' (301-334-9180 in February and March, Herrington Manor HQ) (https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/swallowfalls.aspx).
Website: the entry's website is the booking page only; DNR's camping page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/western/SwallowFalls/Camping.aspx.
